changes: Single VerificationPlan accepts only the host-registered single-human-acceptance-v1 validator with Manual scope and empty arguments.

When all other required checks pass, the host asks the user to accept or decline the exact current candidate and user-request excerpts; a host receipt records question/answer hashes and candidate path hashes.
The host rechecks candidate bytes after the answer, ties accepted historical candidate writes to the current attempt, and lets the independent source reviewer run after human acceptance.

Missing question channel, timeout, malformed/old answer, decline, mutation while waiting, or cancellation cannot produce Accepted; regression-test source covers explicit answer and stale snapshot paths.

Single traces now include an earlier-turn candidate only when the current attempt has an Accepted validation receipt bound to that exact write; validation receipt snapshots also preserve candidate identity when review later blocks delivery.
Accepted Single responses explicitly distinguish human acceptance from automatic behavior-test success.
